verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a design tool, but the evidence pack documents no user-invoked capability to select and act on many items at once. The closest items are adjacent features: automatic design-system application across projects (docs-3), which is a consistency feature, and generating many design directions (docs-2), which is variation generation. Neither is a bulk-operation capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
